title: External Exposure Risk input
description: Analyze up to 100 domains using existing Shodan observations. CVE associations do not confirm vulnerability.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Bare domain names, without URLs or paths. Provide domains or domain, not both.

domain.title: Single domain (API shorthand)
domain.description: Alternative to domains; leave empty/omit when using domains.

shodanApiKey.title: Your Shodan API key
shodanApiKey.description: Customer-supplied secret. Alternatively configure SHODAN_API_KEY as a secret environment variable.

discoverRelatedHosts.title: Discover related hosts
discoverRelatedHosts.description: Optional first-page hostname search; may consume Shodan query credits. Historical hostnames do not prove ownership.

maxIpsPerDomain.title: Maximum IPs per domain
maxIpsPerDomain.description: Cap DNS and related-host lookups per domain. Truncation is reported.

maxServicesPerIp.title: Maximum services per IP
maxServicesPerIp.description: Cap analyzed services per IP; this does not reduce the Shodan host response size.

maxCvesPerDomain.title: Maximum EPSS enrichments per domain
maxCvesPerDomain.description: Cap EPSS enrichment. All observed CVE associations still receive exact KEV correlation.

staleAfterDays.title: Observation freshness window (days)
staleAfterDays.description: Older observations have low confidence and cannot receive high priority.

highEpssThreshold.title: High EPSS probability threshold
highEpssThreshold.description: Probability from 0 to 1, not percentile. Used only with fresh EPSS and credible service evidence.
